announcements.title: Welcome to The FrostlinerZ
announcements.body: Welcome to our Namalsk server! Check the Rules tab before playing and join our Discord for support.

rules.title: 1. No Cheating or Exploiting
rules.body: Any form of hacking, glitching, or combat logging will result in a permanent ban.

rules.title: 2. Respect Other Players
rules.body: No racism, hate speech, or toxicity in voice chat or Discord.

rules.title: 3. Base Building
rules.body: Do not build inside military zones or block main roads.
